Hi I’m Chelsea DeSouza, an LMT and host of Making Selfcare — a podcast for massage therapists. 

I'm re-evaluating the profession from how I show up in my clinic, to the term masseuse, to the beef we have with PT's to how we're viewed in healthcare. 

Governing authorities are changing ordinances left and right and massage therapists should have their voice in the mix. Follow along, listen in, or share your opinion with me and hop on the show!
